paragraphs.text: Holger Burk was a silversmith who became a werewolf , on the plane of Innistrad .

Holger Burk was a distinguished individual, once celebrated as a master silversmith and inducted into the esteemed Order of the Silver Hammer. He possessed a deep sense of duty and loyalty, both to his craft and to his family. His letters reveal him to be a loving husband and father, often expressing his longing for his wife, Adalee, and their children, Jana and Mikel. Holger's personality was marked by bravery, resilience, and a strong moral compass. Despite his eventual transformation into a werewolf, he retained his sense of honor and sought to protect his loved ones and restore his tarnished family name.

Holger's life took a tragic turn after his induction as a master silversmith. During a trip to finalize a deal, he was attacked and cursed by werewolves . Despite the dangers, he continued his journey to help others, but the curse slowly took over his life. His transformation into a werewolf isolated him from his family, leading him to seek refuge in a church in Kessig , led by Adila Rimheit , that harbored and researched werewolves.

Adalee, desperate and hopeful, encouraged Holger to find a cure, but Holger eventually realized there was no way to return to his former life. He resolved to end his days honorably and joined a cause led by Adila, aiming to use his werewolf form to assist in a noble mission. In a final act of bravery, Holger sacrificed himself in a werewolf attack on Thraben Cathedral , hoping to buy time for his ally, Raben Amsel , to complete his mission. He found solace and a sense of relief in ending his tormented existence and hoped his family would remember him with pride.
